findings.title_zh: HITL 主表七个 mode 的 Mean Q / Accept 建立在不同的有效子集上，行间不可比
findings.summary_zh:
Table~2 (tab:hitl-summary) 各 mode 的 Valid 分别是 8/10, 10/10, 8/10, 7/10, 10/10, 8/10, 6/10，而 Mean Q 与 Accept 都只在各自的 valid 子集上计算。这意味着七行数字来自七个不同的 topic 集合，边际均值之间没有可比性。

更严重的是：valid 与否本身是 post-treatment 的结果变量（受 mode 影响），按 valid 条件化等于对撞变量（collider）条件化，会引入选择偏差。论文自己承认失败 topic 系统性更难——'Post-Experiment ... is valid on only 6/10 topics, because late-stage HITL cannot generate experimental evidence from nothing'——这正说明幸存子集的难度分布在各 mode 之间不同。

论文其实做过配对分析（'On matched topics, CoPilot beats Full-Auto by +3.21 and beats Step-by-Step by +2.16'），但 (a) 没有给出 matched topic 的数量，(b) 主表、摘要（main.tex:149）和结论（conclusion.tex:6）用的仍是不可比的边际数 87.5% / 25% / 50%。

附带一处与该列直接冲突的表述：experiment.tex:138 称 Gate-Only 'is the only mode achieving 10/10 validity'，但同一张表里 Step-by-Step 也是 10/10。

locations.excerpt: \textbf{CoPilot} & 8/10  & \textbf{7.27} & \textbf{87.5\%} & 6 \\
Post-Experiment produces some of the strongest individual papers but is valid on only 6/10 topics, because late-stage HITL cannot generate experimental evidence from nothing.
On matched topics, CoPilot beats Full-Auto by $+3.21$ and beats Step-by-Step by $+2.16$.

A human-in-the-loop ablation across seven intervention modes reveals that precise, targeted collaboration at high-leverage decision points consistently outperforms both full autonomy and exhaustive step-by-step oversight.
targeted intervention at high-leverage decision points (CoPilot, 87.5\% accept rate) consistently outperforms both full autonomy (25\%) and exhaustive step-by-step oversight (50\%)
Gate-Only (3 interventions) raises accept rate from 25\% to 50\% and is the only mode achieving 10/10 validity.

findings.reviewer_impact_zh: 审稿人会写："Table 2 is the paper's central evidence for the claim that targeted HITL beats both extremes, yet each row is averaged over a different subset of topics (Valid ranges from 6/10 to 10/10). Because validity is itself an outcome of the intervention regime, conditioning the quality mean and accept rate on validity is conditioning on a post-treatment variable; the reported marginal means are therefore not comparable across rows. Post-Experiment is credited with a 50% accept rate on 6 surviving topics while CoPilot's 87.5% comes from a different set of 8. The authors clearly have the matched-topic data (they quote +3.21 and +2.16) but do not report the matched sample size, matched accept rates, or the matched table. As it stands I cannot verify the paper's main claim." 这条会直接进入 weakness 第一条，并可能被用作 'the central claim is not supported by the reported analysis' 的拒稿理由。

fix.rationale_zh: 不需要补跑任何实验——所有 70 个 run 的结果已经存在。把主表换成 (a) 全 mode 交集 topic 上的配对表（给出 matched N），并把 (b) 全 10 topic 的 intent-to-treat 表作为主结果、conditional-on-valid 表作为附录敏感性分析。摘要与结论必须改用配对或 ITT 数字。
fix.proposed: Replace Table 2 with two panels. Panel A (primary): intent-to-treat over all 10 topics, with invalid runs scored at the scale minimum, so every row has denominator 10. Panel B: paired comparison restricted to the K topics on which all seven modes produced a valid run, reporting mean paired differences with a matched N. Move the conditional-on-valid means to the appendix and label them explicitly: "means conditional on validity are not comparable across modes because validity is affected by the intervention regime." In the abstract and conclusion, replace "87.5% accept rate ... versus 25% and 50%" with the paired estimate and its matched sample size. Also correct "Gate-Only ... is the only mode achieving 10/10 validity": Step-by-Step also achieves 10/10.

findings.title_zh: 组件消融的 Quality 只在 completed topic 上取均值，"debate 是最大质量贡献者"在补齐未完成 run 后反转
findings.summary_zh:
Table~5 (tab:component-abl) 的 caption 明确写 'Quality is the mean of the selected best scores over completed topics'。各行 Completion 为 10/10, 10/10, 6/10, 9/10, 10/10, 4/10，因此 Quality 列同样是在六个不同子集上算的。论文据此断言 'Multi-agent debate is the largest quality contributor ($-1.37$, $p{=}0.003$)'，并把 self-healing 归类为 'the largest completion contributor'（而非质量贡献者）。

但论文自己在同一段写道 'surviving topics are disproportionately easier'——既然承认幸存子集更容易，w/o Self-Healing 的 4.83 就是在一个被挑简单了的 6 个 topic 上算的，与 Full 的 10 个 topic 不可比。把未完成 run 按量表下界补齐后，self-healing 的质量损失（-2.32）反而大于 debate（-1.37），论文的机制排序结论直接反转。

同一张表的 Accept 列内部分母口径还不自洽：caption 说 Accept 只数 completed 输出，但 w/o Evolution 行 Completion=9/10 而 Accept 写作 2/10（应为 x/9），w/o Self-Healing 用 1/6、w/o Debate \& Healing 用 0/4，同一列混用三种分母。

locations.excerpt: Completion counts topics for which at least one rerun completed a manuscript. Quality is the mean of the selected best scores over completed topics, and Accept counts selected completed outputs with score $\ge 5$.
\quad w/o Self-Healing      & 6/10           & 4.83          & 1/6                       & \xmark \\
\quad w/o Evolution         & 9/10           & 5.14          & 2/10                      & \xmark \\

Multi-agent debate is the largest quality contributor ($-1.37$, $p{=}0.003$): without the Pragmatist filtering infeasible hypotheses and the Skeptic scrutinizing weak findings, both hypothesis quality and result analysis degrade. Self-healing is the largest completion contributor: removing it reduces completion from 10/10 to 6/10 even with three attempts per topic, because the first unrecovered runtime error terminates the run and surviving topics are disproportionately easier.
Component ablation confirms that the mechanisms are complementary: debate drives quality, self-healing drives completion, verification enforces integrity

findings.reviewer_impact_zh: 审稿人会写："The ablation's Quality column is averaged over completed topics only, and completion varies from 4/10 to 10/10 across rows. The authors themselves note that 'surviving topics are disproportionately easier', which means the w/o Self-Healing quality of 4.83 is measured on an easier subset than the full system's 5.62. If non-completed topics are scored at the scale minimum, self-healing becomes the largest quality contributor (-2.32) rather than debate (-1.37), reversing the paper's stated mechanism ranking. The Accept column also mixes denominators: the w/o Evolution row completes 9/10 topics but reports 2/10." 这条对 contribution 归因的打击很直接，因为 debate 是论文排第一的机制。

fix.rationale_zh: 同样无需补跑：把 Quality 改成对全部 10 个 topic 的 intent-to-treat 均值（未完成计量表下界），或额外给一列 'completed-only'，并统一 Accept 分母为 /10。机制排序的论断必须按新口径重写。
fix.proposed: Report Quality over all 10 topics (non-completed runs scored at the scale minimum) as the primary column, and keep the completed-only mean as a secondary column labelled as conditional. Fix the Accept column to a single denominator (x/10 for every row). Revise the text to: "Under a completion-adjusted accounting, self-healing is the largest single-mechanism contributor to quality (-2.32) as well as to completion; debate contributes -1.37 among topics that complete in both configurations."

findings.title_zh: 端到端 1--10 分似由系统自身 Stage-20 Quality_Gate 产生，而七个 mode 中有四个恰好在 Stage 20 介入
findings.summary_zh:
端到端评测的主指标是 'overall paper quality on a 1--10 scale with accept rate ($\geq 5$) as the primary metric'，但论文从未说明这个分数由谁给出。附录 case study 反复称之为 'Stage-20 score'（Full-Auto 4.0 / CoPilot 8.0），正文也写 'The Stage-20 quality gate therefore accepts it'。而 Stage 20 = \textsc{Quality\_Gate}，是 AutoResearchClaw 自身流水线的一个阶段，同时被标注为 'HITL Gate'。

按 tab:mode-mapping，介入 Stage 20 的 mode 是 Gate-Only(5,9,20)、CoPilot(...,20)、Step-by-Step(全 23 stage)、Post-Experiment(14,17,20)；不介入 Stage 20 的是 Full-Auto 与 Pre-Experiment。Table 2 里 Mean Q 最低的两行恰好就是这两个不碰 Stage 20 的 mode（4.03 与 4.28），四个碰 Stage 20 的 mode 全部在 4.86--7.27 区间。

这构成测量效度问题：处理（人类介入）作用在评分器本身上，评分与处理不独立。无论真实机制是什么，读者无法区分 'CoPilot 产出的论文更好' 与 'CoPilot 让人在打分环节介入了'。退一步说，即使分数其实来自独立评委，论文也没有披露评分者身份，这本身就是协议缺失。

locations.excerpt: The \emph{end-to-end} mode evaluates the full pipeline from research idea to completed paper, assessing overall paper quality on a 1--10 scale with accept rate ($\geq 5$) as the primary metric.
The final CoPilot paper remains exploratory, but it reports nonzero contrasts across nine pipelines and states its limitations clearly. The Stage-20 quality gate therefore accepts it.
limitations are stated explicitly, and the Stage-20 gate accepts the manuscript because claims align with the logs. Stage-20 score: 8.0.
20 & \textsc{Quality\_Gate} & quality\_report.json & HITL Gate \\
CoPilot & 5, 8, 9, 14, 17, 20 (+ smart pauses) & Full intervention with auto-approve \\

findings.reviewer_impact_zh: 审稿人会写："Who assigns the 1--10 paper-quality score is never stated. The appendix calls it the 'Stage-20 score' and Stage 20 is the system's own Quality_Gate, which is simultaneously one of the HITL gates. Four of the seven regimes (Gate-Only, CoPilot, Step-by-Step, Post-Experiment) inject human input at Stage 20; the two regimes that do not (Full-Auto, Pre-Experiment) are exactly the two lowest-scoring rows. The outcome metric is thus produced at a stage that the treatment manipulates. This is circular and the HITL ranking cannot be interpreted." 这条是本文最容易被一句话击穿核心贡献的地方，因为 HITL 结论是论文标题里 'Human-AI Collaboration' 的唯一实证支撑。

fix.rationale_zh: 最低成本的修法是把 70 份已生成的论文交给一个与流水线解耦的评委重新打分（不需要重跑 pipeline）：7 mode x 10 topic = 70 次评分调用，估计几小时、数十美元量级，截稿前可完成。如果分数本来就来自独立评委，那么只需在 §4.1 明确写出评分者、prompt 与它与 Stage 20 的关系，此时降为 mechanical 修正。
fix.proposed: State explicitly in Section 4.1 who produces the end-to-end 1--10 score. If it is the system's Stage-20 Quality_Gate, re-score all 70 HITL deliverables with an external judge that is not part of the pipeline and that is blind to the intervention regime, and report the HITL table under that external score. Add a sentence acknowledging that four of the seven regimes intervene at Stage 20 and that the self-reported gate score is therefore not a valid outcome measure for those regimes.

findings.title_zh: ARC-Bench 评分 rubric 直接以本系统的内部产物路径（stage-14/experiment_summary.json）为给分条件
findings.summary_zh:
附录公布的 T01 rubric 中，Code Execution 叶子 t01-exec-metrics（权重 16.67，占 CE 全部权重的三分之二）写的是：'Machine-readable artifact (\texttt{results/metrics.json} or \texttt{stage-14/experiment\_summary.json})'。其中 \texttt{stage-14/} 是 AutoResearchClaw 自己的阶段编号（Stage 14 = \textsc{Result\_Analysis}，见 tab:all\_stages），即评分标准把本系统的内部文件布局写进了给分条件。

论文同时满足三个条件：作者设计 benchmark、作者设计 rubric 与 judge prompt、作者的系统被这套 rubric 评测，而基线系统按各自的格式输出。这是典型的 benchmark 自我偏好风险，而论文没有做任何格式归一化或盲评控制。

作者显然意识到这个问题：仓库源码里有一整节被注释掉的 'Judge and Rubric Issues'，其中 (vi) 明确写道 'Some of RC's apparent advantage may reflect adapter/finalizer style alignment with the rubric. A blind, normalized-writeup or metric-table-only judge would be a useful ablation'，(v) 还写 'It would also reduce schema-mismatch penalties for AISv2, since AISv2 uses baseline and research\_best naming while RC uses ARC-style condition keys'。这两段没有出现在编译出的论文里。

locations.excerpt:
Machine-readable artifact (\texttt{results/metrics.json} or
\texttt{stage-14/experiment\_summary.json}) with numeric accuracy \emph{and}
a calibration metric (ECE, NLL, or Brier score) covering all conditions on
at least one dataset.
14 & \textsc{Result\_Analysis} & analysis.md + charts & Debate ($K{=}3$) \\
The strict judge grades each (framework $\times$ topic) cell along three dimensions weighted as CD:CE:RA = 25:25:50.

% \paragraph{(vi) Style bias.} RC writeups are usually rubric-aware replication reports while AISv2 writeups are research-narrative-style. Some of RC's apparent advantage may reflect adapter/finalizer style alignment with the rubric. A blind, normalized-writeup or metric-table-only judge would be a useful ablation.
It would also reduce schema-mismatch penalties for AISv2, since AISv2 uses \texttt{baseline} and \texttt{research\_best} naming while RC uses ARC-style condition keys.

  CE 在 overall_strict 中占 25%，故该叶子对 Overall 的直接影响 = 0.25 * 0.667 = 16.7 个百分点。

  与 AI Scientist v2 的差 = 0.648 - 0.419 = 0.229。

findings.reviewer_impact_zh: 审稿人会写："The benchmark, the rubric and the judge are all authored by the same group that authors the system under evaluation, and the published rubric literally names the proposed system's internal artifact path (stage-14/experiment_summary.json) as a scoring target. A baseline that writes its metrics elsewhere is penalised for schema mismatch rather than for scientific quality. Since this single leaf carries two thirds of the Code Execution weight, and Code Execution is a quarter of the headline score, the reported 54.7% advantage cannot be separated from format alignment. A blind, normalised-writeup judge is needed." 这条会被直接引用为 'the main comparison is confounded'。

fix.rationale_zh: 补做代价可控：不需要重跑任何系统，只需把已有的 4 系统 x 25 topic = 100 个 cell 的产物做格式归一化后重新评分（约 100 次 judge 调用，1 天内可完成），报告归一化前后的分差。同时把 rubric 里的 stage-14/experiment_summary.json 换成与系统无关的通用描述。
fix.proposed: Rewrite the rubric leaf as "a machine-readable metrics artifact in any location, discoverable from the submission README", removing all references to AutoResearchClaw's internal stage paths. Add a normalisation ablation: convert every system's outputs to a common condition x dataset x seed x metric table before judging, re-score all 100 cells, and report both the raw and normalised Overall columns. Restore the 'Judge and Rubric Issues' appendix (currently commented out in the source), in particular items (v) schema mismatch and (vi) style bias.

findings.title_zh: Table 3 的 Overall 列无法按 caption 声明的聚合规则复算，且三行使用了不同的分母
findings.summary_zh:
tab:scidomain 的 caption 明确规定了聚合规则：'Failed runs are counted as zero when computing the run-weighted overall mean over the 20 science-domain tasks'，且正文说明任务构成为 biology B01--B07 (7)、statistics S01--S03 (3)、HEP-ph P01--P10 (10)，合计 20。

按这个规则复算，三行的 Overall 都对不上：两个基线的印刷值对应的分母是 15 而不是 20；本系统的印刷值 0.867 则对应 HEP 只贡献约 1 个任务（而不是 10 个）的权重。也就是说，同一列的三个数字使用了互相不同、且都不是 caption 所声明的聚合方式，而这一列正是 '本系统覆盖跨领域、基线不覆盖' 这一 claim 的量化载体。

另外正文说 'the third statistics run completed the pipeline but failed the requirements judge on missing metric artifacts and is therefore excluded from the column mean'——本系统的失败 run 被排除，而基线的失败 run 被计零，两类失败的处理方式不一致。

findings.reviewer_impact_zh: 审稿人会写："Table 3's Overall column does not follow the rule stated in its own caption. With 7 biology, 3 statistics and 10 HEP tasks and failures counted as zero, AIDE-ML's Overall should be 0.068, not 0.090 (the printed value implies a denominator of 15), and the proposed system's should be 0.698, not 0.867 (the printed value implies HEP contributes the weight of roughly one task). Three rows of the same column use three different aggregation rules, and the one that deviates most is the authors' own. I cannot reproduce any number in this column." 这种 'caption 自带公式但复算不上' 的问题在 rebuttal 里几乎无法辩解，会被作为 sloppiness 或更严重问题的证据。

fix.rationale_zh: 必须回到原始 per-task 分数重新聚合并公布 per-task 表。若 0.867 来自某种未声明的加权（例如按领域等权、或排除 HEP 的部分子任务），必须在 caption 里写清楚，并对三行使用同一规则。
fix.proposed: Publish the 20 per-task scores for all three systems and recompute the Overall column with a single, stated rule applied identically to every row. findings.summary_zh:

(1) 未说明检验类型（配对 t、Wilcoxon、bootstrap？）、单双侧、自由度；
(2) 该 p 值算在 best-of-3 选出的分数上——best-of-N 选择会改变分布形状（右截尾），对选择后的极值做标准配对检验，名义 p 值不再有效；
(3) 未做多重比较校正：同表有 5 个消融对照 x 3 个指标 = 15 次隐含比较；
(4) 选择性报告：4 个单组件移除行里只有 debate 这一行给了 p 值，而恰好是 w/o Self-Healing 与 w/o Evolution 两行涉及分母变化、更需要统计说明。

findings.title_zh: 缺少"无脚手架"平凡对照：系统把复杂任务直接派发给外部编码 agent，而该 agent 单独运行的成绩从未测量
findings.summary_zh:
系统在 Stage 10 使用 cascade：'Beast Mode (external AI agent) $\to$ CodeAgent $\to$ Legacy single-shot'，复杂度 $c > \tau = 0.6$ 的实验被 'dispatched to an external AI coding agent'；科学领域任务则 'Each specialized agent runs inside a Claude Code subprocess with the requisite packages pre-installed'。也就是说，本系统在关键的代码生成与执行环节，把工作交给了一个成熟的外部编码 agent。

R1.6 意义上的其它平凡对照也没有：没有 'no-op / 人类专家写的参考解' 上界，没有 'single-agent 一次性 prompt' 下界。

findings.summary_zh:

这带来两个问题：(1) 判定标准是事后从失败模式反推的，不是前置声明的；(2) Stage 17 闸门是本系统的一个组件，用它来定义 '有效样本' 意味着有效性判定与被评系统耦合——附录自己写 'The stage-17 hard block is correct as a safety check but currently conflates heterogeneous causes'，即这个闸门把四类完全不同的失败（无 metric、依赖缺失、数据集加载失败、设计过于野心）合并成同一个 invalid 标签，而这四类对 mode 的敏感性显然不同。

findings.summary_zh:

findings.title_zh: 设计空间扫描（K、半衰期）只给相对百分比与定性结论，无绝对数值、无方差、未与主指标挂钩
findings.summary_zh:
附录 §Design-Space Exploration 是 R2.6 要求的参数扫描，值得肯定它存在。但报告方式无法核查：$K \in \{2,3,5\}$ 的结论是 '$K{=}2$ ... $-23\%$ hypothesis diversity'、'$K{=}5$ raises tokens by $+67\%$ for only $+8\%$ diversity'，全部是相对百分比，没有 'hypothesis diversity' 的定义与绝对值，没有离散度，没有说明这 10 runs each 跑在哪些 topic 上，也没有报告 K 对最终 quality/accept 的影响——而 quality 才是全文的主指标。
半衰期扫描 $T_{1/2} \in \{7,15,30,60,\infty\}$ 只有定性描述（'gave the best quality trajectory'），连相对数字都没有。这意味着 $K{=}3$ 与 $T_{1/2}{=}30$ 这两个贯穿全文的默认值，其选择依据不可复核。

locations.excerpt:
\paragraph{Number of debate agents ($K$).}
We tested $K \in \{2, 3, 5\}$ across 10 runs each. $K{=}2$ degenerates into a
pro/con dynamic with $-23\%$ hypothesis diversity. $K{=}5$ raises tokens by $+67\%$
for only $+8\%$ diversity over $K{=}3$

We tested $T_{1/2} \in \{7, 15, 30, 60, \infty\}$ days. $T_{1/2}{=}7$ expires
useful lessons too fast; $T_{1/2}{=}\infty$ accumulates contradictory advice past
15 runs. $T_{1/2}{=}30$ gave the best quality trajectory, persisting long enough to
influence 3--5 subsequent runs while gradually fading.
where $\Delta t$ is the elapsed time since the lesson was recorded and $T_{1/2}$ is a half-life hyperparameter controlling how quickly older lessons lose influence (default $T_{1/2} = 30$ days).

The two design constants used throughout the paper (K=3, half-life 30 days) are therefore not justified in a checkable way." 属于扣印象分而非致命，但补起来很便宜。

findings.title_zh: 在 [0,1] 有界 rubric 分上用相对提升幅度做 headline（54.7% / 100.4%），属可辩护的取舍但会被读作放大
findings.summary_zh:
摘要、引言、结论三处都用 'outperforms AI Scientist v2 by 54.7\%'，正文还有 'a 100.4\% relative improvement'。这些百分比在算术上都正确，但它们是有界 rubric 分（0--1）上的相对差，分母越小放大越厉害：Result Analysis 那一项之所以有 100.4%，主要是因为基线只有 0.261。绝对差分别是 0.229 与 0.262。

这是**设计选择**而非错误——很多系统论文都这么写。但在一个 headline 只报相对值、而主表分数带宽有限的语境下，审稿人容易读成刻意放大，尤其是当同一篇论文的失败计零口径（见 P2-RIGOR-006）也在往同一方向推的时候。是否调整由作者判断。
